name: pr-gutter
description: Shows git diff highlighting in the gutter between current branch and a configurable target branch

pr-gutter.targetBranch.description: The target branch to compare against. Leave empty to auto-detect the repository's default branch (origin/HEAD, falling back to main/master/develop/trunk). Ignored if targetCommit is set.

pr-gutter.targetCommit.description: The target commit hash to compare against (takes precedence over targetBranch if set)

pr-gutter.autoRefresh.description: Automatically refresh diff when files change

pr-gutter.liveUpdate.description: Update decorations while typing (unsaved changes are diffed against the target). Requires autoRefresh.

pr-gutter.showOutline.description: Show border outline around changed lines

pr-gutter.showGutterIcons.description: Show emoji icons in the gutter for changed lines

pr-gutter.showStartupNotification.description: Show a notification when the extension activates (the status bar item indicates activation instead)

scripts.reinstall: npm run package:vsix && (code --uninstall-extension marcneubauer.pr-gutter || true) && code --install-extension "$(ls -t *.vsix | head -n 1)"
